Issue Description: DESIGN SYSTEM DEFECT (root cause): the Hover variant uses bg #4398d4 with #ffffff label = 3.14:1. Button labels are 16px Semibold (L), 14px Bold (M), 12px Bold (S) — none meet the WCAG "large text" threshold (>=18.66px bold), so all require 4.5:1. Every primary button on the live site inherits this. Confirmed failing in production.
Current Value: bg #4398d4 + text #ffffff = 3.14:1 (needs 4.5:1) — all 3 sizes
Required Fix (exact): Change Hover bg to #2a6fa8 (white text = 5.33:1 PASS). Alternative if the lighter blue must stay: keep #4398d4 and change label to #171717 (5.70:1 PASS). Apply to the Hover variant of all 4 Types x 3 Sizes (12 variants).
Notes / Affected Pages: NOTE: the original seed table cited "#2a6fa8 (7.1:1)" — recomputed from the real component fills, the true ratio is 5.33:1. Still passes AA. Fixing this one variant set fixes the hover failure site-wide.

Issue Description: Disabled variant is bg #d4d4d4 with #a3a3a3 label = 1.70:1. WCAG 1.4.3 exempts disabled controls, so this is NOT a strict AA failure — but at 1.70:1 the label is effectively unreadable, which is a usability/low-vision problem and commonly flagged in audits.
Current Value: bg #d4d4d4 + text #a3a3a3 = 1.70:1
Required Fix (exact): Set Disabled to bg #e5e5e5 + label #595959 = 5.56:1, keeping it visually distinct from Default. Do not rely on color alone to signal disabled — also set aria-disabled/disabled in code.
Notes / Affected Pages: Flagged as best-practice, not a conformance blocker. Deprioritize below the Hover fix.

Issue Description: GOOD NEWS / DRIFT: the Focus variant IS correctly designed — 2px #4398d4 ring on #164291 bg = 3.01:1 vs the button, 3.14:1 vs a white page. Both clear 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The live site does not implement it: 69/69 pages showed no visible focus indicator. This is a build gap, not a design gap.
Current Value: Design: 2px #4398d4 ring (3.01:1 / 3.14:1 = PASS). Live site: no focus indicator on 69/69 pages.
Required Fix (exact): Dev to implement the designed focus ring in CSS: :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4398d4; outline-offset: 2px; }. Do NOT ship outline:none. Ratio is marginal (3.01:1) — if the ring is ever placed on a lighter bg, switch to #164291 (9.45:1 on white).
Notes / Affected Pages: Highest-leverage dev fix: the design already exists and is compliant, so this is pure implementation. Resolves the 69/69-page focus finding from Phase 1.

Issue Description: No Input/Text-Field/Select/Checkbox component set exists in the library (29 component sets scanned; only icon components matched). Form fields are drawn ad-hoc per screen, so error/focus/disabled field states are inconsistent and unspecified — matching the live-site finding that error text is not programmatically associated with its field.
Current Value: 0 input/field component sets found among 29 sets
Required Fix (exact): Create an Input component set with variants: Default, Focus (2px #164291 ring = 9.45:1), Error (border #e30910 + icon + message text, never color alone), Disabled, Filled. Annotate each with the required aria: id on message, aria-describedby on input, aria-invalid="true", role="alert" on the live error.
Notes / Affected Pages: Error visuals do exist on individual screens (17 error-named layers in the UI Designs page) but are not componentized or annotated.
